source: Direct authMiddleware invocation with pool.query instrumentation after auth/session middleware optimization
baselineSource: Pre-fix authMiddleware issued three queries for a valid non-admin session: session lookup, workspace membership validation, and session activity update.

queries.sql: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.workspace_id, s.expires_at, s.last_activity, s.created_at, u.is_super_admin, wm.id as membership_id FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN workspace_memberships wm ON wm.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.id = $1
UPDATE sessions SET last_activity = $1 WHERE id = $2
